digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow - pytest job
propositions: The macOS pytest job (py3.13) dominates the Gerrit Verified gate critical path at 18.6m, with 15.4m spent in coverage collection that produces no consumed output.
Coverage enforcement via fail_under = 70 is redundantly gated three times over on ubuntu cells running the identical test selection, making macOS coverage collection duplicate work.
macOS runner concurrency is capped at 4, causing changes to queue 6.7-8.4m waiting for a macOS runner, so reducing macOS job duration directly reduces gate latency for concurrent submissions.
The proposed change removes --cov and --cov-report flags from macOS matrix cells only, retaining identical test execution (7856 tests) and keeping ubuntu coverage gates intact.
The conditional flag logic must use the || empty-string form to avoid GitHub Actions' falsy-string evaluation silently re-enabling coverage on macOS.
Post-merge verification requires observing the actual macOS command line to confirm --cov absence and measuring the speedup on the next Verified run after workflow propagation.
